final_correspondences.reviewer_rationale: Introductory ending causative is a complete established predicate. The passive auxiliary and explanatory subject are outside its English span.
Exhaustion/result member zad uniquely corresponds to end inside the introductory causative, not the later result.
Causative byed uniquely supplies brought inside that same parent. It does not claim the passive auxiliary.
Manner tshul has the overt interrogative manner exponent how in this introduction.
Chos bzod pa is the doctrinal mastery-of-phenomena unit. GMR supplies the leading the; its exclusion is sound.
Chos is the phenomena member of that particular compound, strictly inside the parent on both sides.
Bzod pa is the mastery member; English member order reverses Tibetan order and the resolver keeps the same parent.
The first dang joins the two enumerated groups and owns as well as. The later dang is a separation complement.
The first desire is attachment from which the path is free; the realm qualifier at the end is another occurrence.
Bral ba expresses freedom from the immediately preceding desire. Free of is complete enough as a relational predicate; which is is supplied grammar.
The established uninterrupted-path unit belongs to the eight instants. The bracketed path of seeing does not supply its path occurrence.
Bar chad med is the unique interruption-free modifier within this path; med scopes interruption and is not a separate English negative atom.
Lam owns the path within the compound at 211–215, not the explanatory bracket at 229–233.
Brgyad counts eight. The English counting noun instants is explanatory and excluded.
Sems pa is the mental movement associated with the twelve types; its morphology does not justify separate mental or movement members.
Rnam pa distinguishes the types of those mental movements and matches types.
Bcu gnyis is twelve as one numeral; no ten or two is separately present in English.
De resumes the previously enumerated twelve types as These in the next sentence.
Nag po qualifies the black deeds being ended. It does not own the supplied object noun deeds.
The second zad supplies end after black deeds. The resultative frame to an is excluded from the narrower lexical atom.
The second byed supplies act in the causative clause. To bring is a distributed expansion, so the narrower atom is preferable.
Las denotes the acting deeds at 323–328; the opening explanatory deeds and later black-deeds object are distinct and unclaimed.
The contracted 'dod in 'dod nyon denotes the desire realm. The clause itself supplies the contextual realm sense; this is not the earlier attachment noun.
Nyon is the contracted affliction noun in that realm expression. Mental afflictions is its local exponent; all the and the relative frame remain outside.
Spong is elimination of those desire-realm afflictions, at the only eliminate occurrence.
Final byed is function in function to eliminate; the earlier act and brought occurrences belong to other causatives.
Final phyir marks the reason for the whole preceding classification and owns causal for, excluding they.
The complete inflected uninterrupted-path expression retains its internal genitive; the term as a whole is locally and lexically established.
Bar chad med owns uninterrupted within the same parent; negation applies to interruption.
Lam owns only path within that same technical parent.
Dgu pa is the ordinal ninth; supplied instant is not included.
Sems pa is the mental movement identified by the opening relative construction.
Gang yin pa is a relative identifying construction with a copula, corresponding to which is. D3 reflects that source phrase; it is not an isolated lexical pronoun or a d7 parent.
De resumes the identified mental movement as This at the next sentence start.
Dkar gnag is the established dual-color unit and locally means white and black. Its internal conjunction needs no fabricated standalone dang.
Dkar uniquely supplies white within the compound.
Gnag uniquely supplies black within the compound; NAG elsewhere is not grounds to alter this spelling.
Zad supplies end as the result of the act. The narrower lexical atom avoids assigning the distributed resultative par.
Byed supplies acts. The main deed predicate is distinct from the subsequent elimination mechanisms.
Las owns deed; the preceding a and copula remain outside.
The first 'dod pa qualifies virtue and owns the hyphenated desire-realm, not either later bare desire expression.
Dge ba is the virtue eliminated by relinquishing aspiration. Its prose occurrence is locally attested without changing the curated master goodness gloss.
La marks virtue as the object of aspiration/desire. For at 267–270 is that relation; it is a supplied anaphor and excluded.

final_correspondences.eng: eliminating the aspiration, or the desire
final_correspondences.reviewer_rationale: Complete 'dun pa 'dod chags dang bral ba states release from aspiration/desire. The active English eliminating the aspiration, or the desire preserves that whole relation; internal articles and apposition serve it. This is not a bare bral ba/eliminating lexical equivalence, and does not borrow either finite spong predicate. Local objects, release direction, and the means attachment support D3 independently of the glossary or corpus substring totals.

Sgo nas is an established lexical means idiom, used here to introduce the preceding release relation as the means of abandoning virtue. D5 is defensible; neither sgo nor nas receives an invented member.
First spong owns first finite eliminates at 181–191, whose object is desire-realm virtue; it does not own the intervening eliminating.
Second 'dod pa qualifies the mental afflictions and takes desire realm in the Secondly clause.
Nyon mongs denotes the afflictions eliminated in the second mechanism. All the is excluded.
Thob pa is the retaining factor rendered hold. Which retains them explains that single factor and cannot create a second occurrence.
Chad pa states cessation of the retaining hold; stops is its overt local predicate, excluding the supplied agent one.
Tshul is the manner/process of that cessation. Here being that is explanatory English and not part of the lexical atom.
Second spong ba owns finite eliminates at 288–298, with the afflictions as object. Both finite English predicates have distinct Tibetan predicates.
Final phyir supplies because introducing both reasons. First of all and Secondly organize the English and stay unwrapped.
Bsam gtan denotes a concentration level in this numbered context; the complete level of concentration is locally attested and is a glossary expression.
Bzhi pa is fourth in this source. No third is stated here, despite a noisy mined master suggestion.
First la marks the fourth concentration as the object of desire and owns first English for at 107–110.
First desire is attachment toward that fourth concentration, within the path modifier.
First bral ba corresponds directly to free of. The later freedom/manner relation is compressed elsewhere and is not this occurrence.
The uninterrupted-path compound is complete and the subject of the arising expression.
The modifier bar chad med is unique within the technical parent and keeps negation on interruption.
Lam owns path within that same parent.
Skyes pa is nominal arising of the path; the final instant modifies that arising.
Tha mas is the instrumentally inflected last/final expression. Final is local lexical content; its source -s stays attached and the wider It is by this frame remains unwrapped.
Dkar po owns white; deeds is supplied from the discussion and there is no local las to duplicate.
The complete end-causing predicate corresponds to the contiguous brought to an end. Are is excluded.
Zad uniquely owns end within this causative parent.
Byed uniquely owns brought within this same parent.
Dge ba remains virtue independently of the disputed realm label. Keeping it does not assert gzugs/formless realm.
Second la marks virtue as the object of aspiration/desire; it owns third English for at 252–255, beyond the causal for.
'Dun pa owns aspiration in the compressed final explanation; no separate phrase claims the same English.
Second 'dod chags owns the appositional desire, after aspiration, not the earlier path-modifier desire.

Spong ba is the only main elimination predicate, with the English eliminates. The intervening freedom/manner construction contributes distributively and receives neither a duplicate exponent nor a false null.
Phyir is the causal for at 200–203; the first and third for are the two la complements.
